target_paper.title: AIRepr: An Analyst-Inspector Framework for Evaluating Reproducibility of LLMs in Data Science
target_paper.original_source: Table 6, DiscoveryBench rows for the o3-mini analyst (239 tasks)

generation.endpoint: POST https://api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions (harness/openai_client.py); the original used the Azure deployment o3-mini-2025-01-31, api-version 2024-12-01-preview, via LangChain AzureChatOpenAI
generation.parameters: {'reasoning_effort': 'low', 'max_completion_tokens': 4000}; no temperature (the original's temperature=1 was a LangChain requirement and is o3-mini's only legal value); no API seed - seed_idx is a repeat index
generation.inspector: o3-mini-2025-01-31 itself instead of gpt-4o-2024-11-20 (paper Section 5.6 / Figure 7, r = 0.98 on QRData); the repo's ('system', ...) message is sent as role 'developer'
generation.battery: analyst 2 calls per task-seed; inspector up to 4 (accuracy always, workflow-to-code / conclusion / similarity only when the analyst code executes); 239 tasks x 2 prompts x 3 seeds

code_execution.mode: fresh isolated interpreter per snippet (subprocess.run python -I -X utf8, outbound sockets blocked)
code_execution.repo_tool: utils.code_execution.CustomPythonAstREPLTool, imported in the child; the repo itself exec()s in-process with os.chdir, no timeout and no isolation

judge_noise_probe.design: inspector repeated on the seed-0 analyst outputs of the first 100 tasks (seed_idx 90)

results.judged_by: automatic rule per ANALYSIS_PLAN section 1 as the card instantiates it, restricted to DiscoveryBench: survived = RoT - CoT positive with a task-level bootstrap 95% CI excluding 0 AND both reproducibility levels within 10 pp of Table 6; partial = positive but the CI includes 0 or a level moved; dead = RoT lowers reproducibility. The card's 'positive on at least 2 of 3 benchmarks' clause is NOT evaluable under the DiscoveryBench-only scope and is recorded as unmet-by-design; human double-coding pending
results.note: RoT - CoT = +8.37 pp, CI [1.67, 15.06]; a reproducibility level moved more than 10 pp from Table 6

reproducibility_frictions_observed: results/ in the repository contains only __init__.py: no per-task analyst output and no judge verdict was released, so analyst drift cannot be separated from inspector drift by re-scoring archived outputs
the published 'Overall Reproducibility' is the share of tasks scored 1, but eval/run_reproducibility.py reports mean over {1, 0, -1}; for the CoT row the two differ by 13.81 pp (55.23 vs 41.42)

utils/output_parser.ScoreParser returns -1 when a similarity reply cannot be parsed, which collides with the -1 that eval/reproducibility.py uses for inexecutable analyst code; an unparseable accuracy reply silently scores 0
utils/load_data.py derives metadata ids with file_path.split('/')[-1].split('_')[1], which silently mis-parses under Windows separators for the 7 DiscoveryBench subject directories containing '_'
every repository open() call omits encoding=, so the DiscoveryBench metadata JSON fails to load under a non-UTF-8 locale (cp949 here)

agents/prompt_template.py and utils/output_parser.py need langchain's pre-1.0 namespace (StringPromptTemplate, AgentOutputParser), served here from langchain_classic; the tool description that enters the prompt comes from langchain_experimental's PythonAstREPLTool, an unpinned dependency
the repository's sandbox exec()s model-written code in-process with os.chdir, no timeout and no network isolation; this re-run substitutes a fresh isolated interpreter per snippet
the original analyst ran at temperature 1 with no seed (a LangChain constraint), so run-to-run variance of the reasoning outputs is unquantified in the paper; three seeds are used here
the o3-mini inspector's r = 0.98 agreement with gpt-4o (Section 5.6) was measured on QRData, not DiscoveryBench, and the paper reports 'only minor score increases' for it
